description: PowerACE (-) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Chair of Energy Economics; Institute for Industrial Production (IIP); Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT). Power system delevopment taking into account market design options (the internal European market and supplementary market segments in Germany and Europe). Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Methodical focus: agent-based model. Time resolution: hour, 15 min. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, regions, Bidding zones. Software: Java, Gurobi. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
